mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work (owner_id, title, summary, detail, category_id, tags, cover_url, demo_url, video_url, audit_status, visibility_status, publish_status) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{detail}, #{categoryId}, #{tags}, #{coverUrl}, #{demoUrl}, #{videoUrl}, #{auditStatus}, #{visibilityStatus}, #{publishStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM work WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE work SET audit_status = #{auditStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE work SET audit_status = 'APPROVED', approval_reward_granted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND audit_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' AND approval_reward_granted = 0
UPDATE work SET audit_status = 'APPROVED', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND audit_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' AND approval_reward_granted = 1
UPDATE work SET visibility_status = #{visibilityStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work WHERE audit_status = 'APPROVED' AND visibility_status = 'PUBLIC' AND category_id = #{categoryId}
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT w.id, w.title, COUNT(f.id) AS favoriteCount FROM work w LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.target_type='WORK' AND f.target_id=w.id WHERE w.audit_status='APPROVED' AND w.visibility_status='PUBLIC' GROUP BY w.id ORDER BY favoriteCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT w.id, w.title, w.summary, w.cover_url, w.owner_id, a.username AS owner_name, c.name AS category_name, COUNT(f.id) AS favorite_count FROM work w LEFT JOIN account a ON w.owner_id = a.id LEFT JOIN category c ON w.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.target_type='WORK' AND f.target_id=w.id WHERE w.audit_status='APPROVED' AND w.visibility_status='PUBLIC' AND w.category_id = #{categoryId} GROUP BY w.id ORDER BY favorite_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT w.id, w.title, w.summary, w.cover_url, w.owner_id, a.username AS owner_name, c.name AS category_name, COUNT(f.id) AS favorite_count FROM work w LEFT JOIN account a ON w.owner_id = a.id LEFT JOIN category c ON w.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.target_type='WORK' AND f.target_id=w.id AND f.create_time >= #{weekStart} WHERE w.audit_status='APPROVED' AND w.visibility_status='PUBLIC' AND w.category_id = #{categoryId} GROUP BY w.id ORDER BY favorite_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.id) FROM work w LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.target_type='WORK' AND f.target_id=w.id WHERE w.audit_status='APPROVED' AND w.visibility_status='PUBLIC' AND w.category_id = #{categoryId}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.id) FROM work w LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.target_type='WORK' AND f.target_id=w.id AND f.create_time >= #{weekStart} WHERE w.audit_status='APPROVED' AND w.visibility_status='PUBLIC' AND w.category_id = #{categoryId}
